ayahOccurrences.text: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَعْبَؤُا۟ is in the derivative form: يَعْبَأ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ع/ب/أ   ʿ–b–ʾ load, weight; to care, to get ready, to pack. Of this root,يَعْبَؤُ yaʿbaʾu, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَعْبَأ yaʿbaʾ [imperf. v., intrans.] to care, to concern oneself with, to be solicitous about

(25:77)‏مَا‏ ‏يَعْبَؤُ‏ ‏بِكُمْ‏ ‏رَبِّي‏ ‏لَوْلاَ‏ ‏دُعَاؤُكُمْ ‏ what weight have you in the estimation of my Lord [also interpreted as: what will my Lord do with you] if it were not for your supplication?
